objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed document that goes through creation, editing, review, release, and archival cycles with versioning and status tracking

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Draft, Under Review, Released, Archived, or Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Numeric version identifier updated on content or property changes

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which document validity expires

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document automatically released with its parent document and subject to its own versioning

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary document attachment not subject to the release cycle or versioning of the main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed modification to an existing document that can be created by authors without affecting the document version

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person with roles and authorizations in the system

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned with shared authorizations and responsibilities

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A workflow-supported request to extend the validity period of a document before expiration

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A workflow-supported request to invalidate and archive a document

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A workflow-supported request to re-validate a previously invalidated document

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A collection of users and user groups designated to receive document notifications or acknowledgement requests

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object with selection of document type and optional template

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Modify the text and structured information of a document

evts.name: edit_properties
evts.description: Modify document metadata, attributes, and categorized properties

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert edited document to PDF format for web display

evts.name: request_review
evts.description: Initiate the 3-step approval workflow consisting of Creator, Review, and Release steps

evts.name: sign_creator
evts.description: Author electronically signs to confirm document creation in the first workflow step

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content for technical and formal aspects

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser approves and electronically signs to publish the document to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically make document visible to addressed readers following successful release

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Attach a controlled document that requires release with the parent document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archival, triggering a new version of the parent document

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Attach supplementary information not subject to the document release cycle

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Remove additional information directly without affecting document version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Author proposes a modification to an existing document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: Initiate workflow-supported request to extend document validity 30 days before expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Confirm extended validity by designated reviewers, updating the Valid Until date

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create a new document version with retained data from the previous version

evts.name: request_override
evts.description: Initiate workflow-supported request to invalidate a document

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Confirm document invalidation and archiving through workflow approval

evts.name: request_reactivation
evts.description: Initiate workflow-supported request to re-validate an archived document

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Approve reactivation and create a new version of the previously invalidated document

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Designate users or groups with reader, author, reviewer, or releaser roles

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Send email notification to designated users and user groups when document is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Prompt designated users to actively confirm receipt and understanding of a released document

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User workflow-supported confirmation of document acknowledgement without signature

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language-dependent version of a released document in another language

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Translator checks and validates translated document content

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Releaser approves and signs translated document for visibility to language-specific readers

evts.name: view_document
evts.description: Reader access approved document via dashboard or direct retrieval

o2o.description: Document contains attachments that are automatically released with the parent document
Document contains additional information not subject to the parent document release cycle
Change proposal is associated with and proposed for a specific document
Validity extension request is linked to a document for validity checking
Override request is associated with a document to be invalidated
Reactivation request selects a document to be re-validated
Distribution list designates users and groups to receive document notifications
User is a member of one or more user groups
Attachments retain references to the version of the parent document at archival

o2e.description: Create Document event creates a new document object
Edit Content event modifies document content
Edit Properties event modifies document metadata and attributes
Convert to PDF event transforms document to PDF format
Request Review event initiates the approval workflow for a document
Sign Creator event records author signature on document in first workflow step
Review Document event is performed on the document being reviewed
Release Document event records releaser approval and signature
Publish Document event makes document visible following successful release
Revise Document event creates a new version of an existing document
Request Validity Extension event initiates validity check workflow for document
Extend Validity event updates the Valid Until date of a document
Request Override event initiates invalidation workflow for document
Declare Override event marks document as out of force
Request Reactivation event initiates re-validation workflow for archived document
Confirm Reactivation event creates new version of reactivated document
Translate Document event creates language-dependent version of document
Review Translation event validates translated document content
Release Translation event approves translation for reader visibility
View Document event records reader access to approved document
Create Attachment event attaches a controlled document to parent
Archive Attachment event marks attachment for archival
Create Additional Info event adds supplementary information
Delete Additional Info event removes supplementary information
Create Change Proposal event proposes modification to document
Implement Change Proposal event schedules proposal for implementation
Assign Authorization event designates user with specific role
Sign Creator event records electronic signature by author user
Review Document event is performed by reviewer user
Release Document event is performed by releaser user
Confirm Acknowledgement event records user acknowledgement of document
View Document event records reader user access to document
Assign Authorization event designates user group with access rights
Distribute by Email event sends notification to user group members
Request Acknowledgement event prompts user group members for confirmation
Distribute by Email event sends notifications per distribution list configuration
Request Acknowledgement event prompts recipients per distribution list
